pages.text: Work up from the Infinity Bimetal Gear to the Energetic Alloy and Dark Steel versions shown here. Make those alloys in the $(l:enderio:machines/alloying)Alloy Smelter$(/l) and keep a few gears for advanced machine recipes.
The SAG Mill turns one Lapis Lazuli into one Powdered Lapis Lazuli for 2,400 FE. Use that powder, Powdered Coal and Silicon to craft the $(l:enderio:power/photovoltaics)solar composite$(/l).
Compress nine alloy ingots into a storage block. Craft it back into ingots when you need them. An ingot can also split into nine nuggets for smaller parts such as crystals and rods.
